QuestInfo.name: Ellinia Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Wing of Ellinia is making winter preparations for the fairies. How do fairies prepare for winter? If you're curious, go find Wing the Fairy in Ellinia.
QuestInfo.1: Wing the Fairy begrudgingly tells you that fairies can't stand the cold weather. Normal cotton is too heavy for them, so they use a special cotton that's as light as air to stay warm. \nThey haven't been able to obtain this rare cotton yet, and while he doesn't ask for your help out loud, he has a desperate look in his eyes. \nThey say that the cotton, Air-Light Fluff, can be found on the monsters up in Ellinia's treetops.
QuestInfo.2: Wing the Fairy didn't seem very grateful, but you brought him Air-Light Fluff from the monsters of the forest.

0.0: Human, why are you here? You got something to say? \r\n#L0##bMy name is #h0#, not 'human'!#l\n#k
0.1: #h0#? What a funny name. Well, all human names sound the same. Why do I have to memorize your name? If you got no business to discuss, go away! I don't got time for humans.\r\n#L0##bAren't you cold? Fairies get cold too, right?#l\n#k
0.2: What a fool! Of course fairies get cold too. In fact, we can't stand the cold.\r\n#L0##bThen wear something warm.#l\n#k
0.3: You really are stupid, huh? Fairies can't even move if we wear humans' thick clothes! Fairies can't wear any heavy clothes! If it's made of Air-Light Fluff, then maybe... \r\n#L0##bAir-Light Fluff? What's that? Where can I get it?#l\n#k
0.4: You really are annoying. Air-Light Fluff floats in the air, so it's not easy to find. Fairies usually gather about #e#b20 Air-Light Fluffs#k#n and make clothes out of them. I... just didn't know that winter would be here so soon.\r\n#L0##bDo you want me to get you some Air-Light Fluffs?#l\n#k
0.5: N-no thank you! I don't ask humans for no favors! But... if you really want to help me, I won't stop you. But remember, I'm not the one who asked you for a favor!

yes.0: It's won't be easy. Air-Light Fluff is really hard to spot since it's so light and transparent. There's a chance that you might get them from the monsters of #b#eEllinia#n#k high up in the trees.\n\n#i4032559# #b#t4032559# x 20#k

no.0: Fine! I didn't want to ask you for a favor, anyway! Go away! I'm busy!
